issue_context.title: Mat conversions for macOS/AppKit
issue_context.body:
##### System information (version)

- OpenCV => latest
- Operating System / Platform => iOS/macOS
- Compiler => Xcode

##### Detailed description

A conversion method between Mat and UIImage is provided for iOS (UIKit), but it does not exist for macOS (AppKit).
I created a PR https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/18547 to solve this.

review_comments:
It make sense to add some check here with proper error message:

```
#if !defined(__APPLE__)
#error This header should be used in ObjC/Swift projects.
```

(condition may be improved, just a sample)

Thank you. I added a compile guard for non-macOS.
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/18547/commits/57b96317cb9ea27a4edeaf4d064835d64a25b02e

To resolve problem with ABI checker on Linux builder please add this platform-specific header into skip list [here](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/76be3529f491aa5835602021c65ef99975837cac/cmake/templates/opencv_abi.xml.in#L34).

I was having trouble getting rid of the ABI error, but I overlooked this file. Thank you for pointing it out! 🙇‍♂️ 
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/18547/commits/8b1cc75fd53297f45111413087b9f13a31ac3006
